paper_title: Search for ultralight dark matter in the SuperMAG high-fidelity dataset
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi (dimensionless), canonical dark photon coupling
notes: Paper presents NEW measured exclusion limits on dark-photon dark matter (DPDM) using SuperMAG high-fidelity magnetometer dataset (1-second time resolution, 2005–2020). Constraints span 10^-3 Hz ≤ f_DM ≤ 0.98 Hz (4×10^-18 eV ≤ m_DM ≤ 4×10^-15 eV). The paper also constrains axion-like-particle dark matter with coupling g_aγ. For DPDM, the limit is the leading direct constraint in the stated mass range and surpasses the astrophysical Leo T constraint near m_A' ≈ 2×10^-15 eV. No robust DM candidates were identified. The data_points represent the approximate lower and upper bounds of the exclusion region; the actual constraint varies with frequency (shown as a band in Fig. 3). A 25% degradation factor was applied to account for finite signal width. Local DM density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm³ was assumed (standard galactic halo value). The coupling_type is DarkPhoton (kinetic mixing ε) rather than AxionPhoton because the DPDM signal is described by kinetic mixing of a hidden photon with the Standard Model photon.
